deleteAccount.intro: When you delete your account, the following is removed immediately and permanently:

items.account: Your account, profile, preferences and sign-in details

deleteAccount.permanent: This cannot be undone. Deleted data cannot be recovered.
deleteAccount.reasonPlaceholder: Your feedback helps us improve RYVENCA.
deleteAccount.confirmCheck: I understand that my account and all my data will be permanently deleted.
